scripts.developer-docs:generate-openapi: cargo nextest run --profile ci --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml --features openapi --test generate_openapi generate_openapi -- --exact
scripts.developer-docs:dev: bun run developer-docs:generate-openapi && bun run developer-docs:prepare && astro dev --config astro.developer.config.mts
scripts.developer-docs:build: bun run developer-docs:generate-openapi && bun run developer-docs:prepare && astro build --config astro.developer.config.mts
